items.briefing:
Scams are becoming more sophisticated and harder to spot, with AI now helping criminal groups run large-scale fraud operations more effectively than ever. Australian staff should be particularly alert to phishing emails impersonating RingCentral, which are being used to steal Microsoft 365 login credentials — if you receive an unexpected RingCentral message asking you to sign in, do not click the link. Scamwatch is also warning about gambling and betting scams targeting Australians.

If you receive an email asking you to log in to any account, go directly to the website by typing the address yourself rather than clicking any links in the message.

featured.title: SAS Innovate: New era of scams requires novel solutions
featured.quote: Australians losing billions to AI-driven fraud demands urgent industry collaboration solutions.
